onboarding.title: Your onboarding checklist
onboarding.markDoneFailed: We could not save this step. Try again later.

window.welcomeUnavailable: The welcome document is not available yet. Please check again later.
window.activitiesEmpty: There are no current activities yet. Once working groups start their activities, they will be listed here.

onboarding.completeBody: You have finished every onboarding step. Thank you!

profile.title: My profile
profile.intro: This is what other volunteers can learn about you. For each detail you choose who sees it.
profile.checkFields: Some fields are not valid. Check the messages under the fields.
profile.unavailable: We could not save your profile. Try again later.
profile.displayNameHint: The name other volunteers see. It can be a nickname. Always visible to all members.
profile.aiRisks: AI risks you are most invested in

tiers.group: People who share a working group with me

profile.fixedHeading: Only you and the admins see these
profile.noDetails: This volunteer has not shared any more details with you.
profile.activityPlaceholder: Activities will appear here once working groups are live.

errors.invalidUrl: Enter a link that starts with https://

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign-in is for approved volunteers. Use the email address of your application.
login.refused: We could not sign you in. Sign-in only works for approved volunteers, with the email address of their application. If you have not applied yet, apply first.
login.linkSent: If this address can sign in, a link is on its way. Open it in the same browser.
login.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.unavailable: Sign-in is not available right now. Try again later.
login.googleFailed: Google sign-in could not start. Try again or use the email link.

admin.title: Admin
admin.applicationsBlurb: Review people who applied to volunteer.
admin.onboardingBlurb: Tick the onboarding steps that an admin confirms.

onboarding.title: Onboarding
onboarding.intro: Volunteers with at least one open step that an admin confirms. Tick a step when it is done; untick it to take it back. Someone leaves the list when all their steps are done and the page is reloaded.
onboarding.empty: Nobody has an open admin step right now.

errors.invalid: This change is not valid. Reload the page.
errors.notFound: This person or step no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.refused: An admin does not confirm this step.
errors.unavailable: The change could not be saved. Try again.

applications.title: Applications
applications.startLevelHint: Everyone starts as new. Pick a higher level only for someone who is already experienced.
applications.reasonHint: Required when the level is not new. It is kept in the audit log. Do not write personal details.

errors.invalidApplication: This application cannot be found. Reload the page.
errors.reasonRequired: Give a reason for starting above new.

results.doneEmailFailed: Decision saved, but the email could not be sent. Tell the person yourself.
results.notFound: This application no longer exists. Reload the page.
results.conflict: This application was already decided the other way. Reload the page.
results.unavailable: The decision could not be saved. Try again.

apply.title: Apply to volunteer
apply.intro: Fill in the form to apply as a PauseAI Italy volunteer. An admin reviews every application and replies by email.
apply.checkFields: Some fields are not correct. Check the messages under the fields.
apply.tooManyRequests: You have sent too many requests. Try again in a while.
apply.unavailable: We could not send your application. Try again later.
apply.displayNameHint: The name other volunteers will see. It can be a nickname.
apply.emailHint: Use the address you will sign in with. Visible to admins only.
apply.motivation: Why do you want to take part?
apply.motivationHint: Optional. A few lines are enough.
apply.heardVia: How did you hear about PauseAI?
apply.heardOther: Say how you heard about PauseAI
apply.knowledge: How well do you know AI safety?
apply.privacyConsent: I have read and accept the privacy notice.
apply.specialCategoryConsent: I explicitly consent to the processing of my data, which may reveal my political opinions (joining an advocacy group can do so).

applyPending.title: Application received
applyPending.body: Thank you! An admin will review your application and write to the email address you gave.
applyPending.signIn: You cannot sign in until the application is approved. When it is, you will get a sign-in link.

applyRejected.title: Application not accepted
applyRejected.body: We cannot accept your application at the moment, so you cannot sign in.
applyRejected.reapply: You can apply again at any time.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.stub: The privacy notice is available in Italian only for now. The Italian text below is the one that applies.

devStyle.title: Style guide
devStyle.intro: Every shared primitive in one place. Development only.
devStyle.textHint: As you would like it shown to other volunteers.
devStyle.checkboxLabel: I agree to the privacy notice
devStyle.modalBody: Focus stays inside until it closes. Escape also closes it.
devStyle.emptyBody: When there is something to show it will appear here.
